title: Breeding More
description: Makes vanilla pigs, cows, sheep, and chickens give birth to 2–4 babies instead of just one.
body:
MultiBreed is a lightweight vanilla-friendly datapack that overhauls animal breeding.

When you breed pigs, cows, sheep, or chickens, the parent pair will now produce 2 to 4 offspring instead of the usual single baby.

Perfect for faster farm expansion, more chaotic barnyards, or just reducing the tedium of repetitive breeding.

Features:

Works with all vanilla breedable livestock (pig, cow, sheep, chicken, wolf)

Random litter size is not fixed

No modifications to parent cooldown or other mechanics

Fully multiplayer compatible

Lightweight — no dependencies, just drop in and play

Compatibility:

Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11+

Works with other datapacks that don't significantly alter breeding logic

Installation:
Download the .zip and place it in your world's datapacks/ folder. That's it.
